scope: Read-only inspection of the SSH-visible container, BEHAVIOR project, process metadata and existing outputs. No training, simulator, inference request, install, restart, remote edit or remote git fetch/pull.
conclusion: No active RL trainer or identifiable current RL implementation/run was found in the inspected scope. Three SFT inference services were found. This does not establish the state of another container, host or unlocated project.
gpu_snapshot_caveat: Instantaneous measurements, not a continuous utilization history or independent proof that no training ever ran.

findings.detail: Last recorded 10100 request failed importing g05.utils.memlite_planner_format before any action was served. A separate new worktree contains a repair, but no process from that worktree or successful post-repair request was observed.

Saved pilot log contains ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER, vkCreateInstance failure, no GPU device creation, and a later vision annotator NoneType exception. Graphics failure is directly evidenced; this audit did not re-run the simulator or independently prove the report's precise platform/cgroup cause.

Dedicated stage1 handler sends the 23D action and logs its norm/count/latency, but does not invoke the existing bridge MemLiteTraceRecorder. Main has no trace-root option. Text logs and a three-event bridge JSONL are not RGB/state/action/reward/terminal trajectories.
findings.scope_limit: A different evaluator or unlocated RL runner could maintain its own recorder; this finding applies to the inspected dedicated server.

failure_trajectory_conclusion: No actual failed policy trajectories were found in these output roots. Setup/request errors must not be relabeled as physical task failures or recovery examples.

sft_results_not_rl.evaluation_protocol: Fixed 3200 windows, 100 tasks; teacher-forced high CE and low FM loss, not success rate.

low.stop_reason_scope: The status itself does not distinguish budget from external signal.

next_required_information: Actual RL repository/run directory, container/SSH endpoint, launcher command or W&B run. Do not diagnose an unseen RL optimizer from inference-service logs.
